content.body: Hello, thank you for sharing the agreement. Before signing, I would kindly request one update: - In the relevant clause, certain claims are excluded from the overall liability cap. I propose modifying this so that the aggregate liability of either party arising from the agreement is capped at USD 35,000. Best regards,
